description.en: Never called from any shipped script in script_clean/, and its native implementation is too involved to fully trace from decompiled code alone. By name and its position among the other chara-management commands, it likely synchronizes an event-controlled character instance's state (position/motion) with its underlying map/battle character.

example.code:
// Sync the event copy of a character with its underlying map character
CMND_SYNC_EVENT_CHARA(hChara);
